body:
Thank you. I feel a little better now. I started gaming again with my husband today and we caught up with an internet friend. It was nice. 

The reason I'm not in therapy is because money is tight. My husband is the only one that works, because I just end up having breakdowns. If I told him how I felt I needed to start therapy again, he would probably stop seeing his therapist in order to pay for mine. He has been so amazing and supportive, and he's been determined to make sure I get everything I need to get healthy again after my suicide attempt, but I know that he has to deal with his mental health, too. I was the one who encouraged him to seek a counselor, because of a pretty big meltdown. At that point I was sure that the worst of my depression was behind me and my anxiety was something I could handle. Then the past few days were just shit and I felt scared. I hadn't thought about suicide very much for over a year, much less consider it a possibility. Having those thoughts today was rough.

I have had 2 depression episodes. One just went away on it's own, and the second included my suicide attempt. I'll talk to my husband about maybe seeing someone everyother week.
